rationale: The plan matches the reference on the core design: balanced batch enters as a covariate (~batch + condition) with control as the explicit reference level, raw counts go into DESeq2 (size factors) and edgeR (TMM) with no pre-adjustment, and BH at alpha 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage is stated. QC covers PCA, sample distances, and library sizes colored by both batch and condition, though the outlier/shallow-sample handling is limited to flagging without a stated action policy. The filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples) is minimal and tied to group size. Enrichment was not asked and is not clearly warranted; the plan runs it anyway with a full ranked list available but chooses ORA on a discrete list by a self-imposed rule, though the universe, named collection/version, size window, and short-list caveat are all explicit. The report specifies method, versions, design, thresholds, n_tested and n_DE, with reasonable caveats.
